title: Smartfire navigation URL contract (cutover step 1)
notes: Machine-readable pin of every navigation URL family and retained boundary from the SPA cutover inventory (AGENTS.md; ~/.cache/spa-cutover-inventory.md sections 1, 5, 6 row 1). Each entry names its broad family pattern plus concrete representative cases that run today over real HTTP against a booted TestApp (see crates/campfire/src/controllers/url_contract_tests.rs). The runner reads ALL expectation state from this file: later default flips and prefix drops must need only expectation edits here, never hardcoded path assertions in the test. Statuses pin 302 (classic navigation redirects, incl. SPA coexistence) vs 303 (POST /app/ui_preference only). Locations pin target query preservation and classic=1 handling. owner_today is one of classic/spa/both/server/static/api. after_cutover.action is one of spa (canonical same-path SPA screen, served or handed off internally without a self-redirect), alias (legacy HTML navigation redirects to target, preserving query context and authorization), retain (existing endpoint and behavior remain). known_bug records current defects or missing screens and their fix_before deadline. Expectations describe this revision, not permission to preserve bugs throughout cutover: fix blockers before their deadline and update their expectations with the behavior change. This review step changes no application behavior.
